constraints: This is an answer-blind shadow policy and does not overwrite promotion v4.
Only existing review_high_priority candidates are evaluated; candidates that fail remain High.
The targeted respiratory assay bridge repairs an evidence-interface gap and is not an analytical-only promotion route.

The bridge requires an exact-species taxonomy mapping, exact-or-alias candidate match, a positive event-aligned targeted respiratory observation, at least three positive tests, cross-molecule reproducibility, and best rank three or better.
The targeted hospital observation and the mNGS analytical signal are separate evidence axes; DNA/RNA agreement itself remains one analytical axis.
History evidence consumed upstream cannot be reused as an independent promotion axis.
Reads remain per-test evidence and are never summed.
Missing evidence or timing remains unknown and does not remove or demote a candidate.
All v4 family-specific Candida, PJP, fungal, viral, and environmental routes remain unchanged.
Benchmark answers are used only after the answer-blind output is frozen.
